reference: Codex / Claude Code / OpenCode style workspace-scoped agent operation
why_relevant: Long-running tasks need workspace-scoped file/tool execution, checkpoints, approvals, hooks, and auditable diffs rather than one-shot chat answers.
project_adaptation: Use repo-local Project OS ledgers, preflight guards, worklogs, and Git hygiene as the durable operating layer.

reference: LangGraph checkpoint, interrupt, resume, time-travel workflow patterns
why_relevant: Research workflows need supervised checkpoints, targeted repair, human review, and replayable state transitions.
project_adaptation: Keep LangGraph research graph but route long-lived state through run audit, WorkpaperEvent, Project OS ledgers, and explicit LeadReviewCheckpoint.

reference: Temporal-style durable workflow, activity history, human signal, retry and timeout policy
why_relevant: Enterprise workbench tasks need durable execution and traceable retries beyond in-process graph calls.
project_adaptation: Use Java backend / SQL audit / task spine first; keep Temporal-style contract as future runtime migration pattern.

reference: MCP-style typed tool gateway and permissioned tool calls
why_relevant: Agents need governed access to DB, files, web, parser, renderer, and data-source tools.
project_adaptation: Maintain tool capability registry, sandbox/approval policy, ToolInvocationLedger, and domain allowlists.

reference: Hermes-style ContextEngine and pluginized memory/context adaptation
why_relevant: Large projects need context resolve/select/compress/inject/write/invalidate instead of relying on raw chat history.
project_adaptation: R57 ContextEngine plus Project OS context pack, method registries, skill/graph lifecycle and stale-memory invalidation.

reference: OpenTelemetry / Langfuse / Phoenix-style traces, eval runs, dataset versioning and quality dashboards
why_relevant: Agent quality must be observable by node, tool, token, retrieval, parser, context injection and final answer.
project_adaptation: R60 eval/observability docs plus AIE/data-script audit, model_call_events, trace spans, and Workbench projection.

reference: Dify / RAGFlow-style RAG pipeline UI, dataset management, workflow configuration and operational dashboard
why_relevant: B端 users need inspectable workflows and knowledge-base/data-source operations, not only chat output.
project_adaptation: Workbench panels for task center, evidence workbench, eval/ops, deliverable studio and data/RAG refresh status.

reference: Feishu/DingTalk/WorkBuddy/Cowork-like enterprise workflow entry, approval, notification, organization-space and document integration
why_relevant: B端 adoption depends on workflow embedding, permission boundaries, auditability, document handling and collaboration.
project_adaptation: PRD positions FIN Insight as analyst workbench with WorkpaperPack, review actions, deliverable studio, dashboard projection and HIL approvals.

reference: P32 L4-fixture-proven checkpoint targeted repair contract
why_relevant: Prevents paid full-chain reruns for node-local defects and keeps repair scoped to earliest faulty artifacts.
project_adaptation: Use LeadReviewCheckpoint, RunAuditStore, ProjectOSPreflight and WorkpaperEvent before any broad paid rerun.

why_relevant: Separates executable tools, context resources and workflow prompts; forces permission, schema, source and artifact refs for tool use.
project_adaptation: Use ToolGateway, ToolInvocationLedger, ToolCapabilityRegistry, SandboxPolicy and ApprovalPolicy as FIN runtime contracts.

reference: P32 L4-fixture-proven durable human-in-the-loop task event contract
why_relevant: B端 research tasks need approval, cancel, resume, timeout and replay semantics beyond chat turns.
project_adaptation: Use SQL-final TaskRun, HumanApprovalEvent, ReviewActionLedger and WorkbenchTaskCenter first; Temporal-style migration remains optional.

reference: P32 L4-fixture-proven GenAI trace / quality / cost contract
why_relevant: Token and tool cost must be attributed to accepted JudgmentCards, memo claims, retrieval docs and eval results rather than tracked as cost alone.
project_adaptation: Use TraceSpan, ModelCallLedger, RetrievalAudit, AgentInformationEconomyLedger and EvalRun with digest/artifact refs.

reference: P32 L4-fixture-proven ContextEngine role-scoped injection contract
why_relevant: Prevents raw memory/evidence dumps and stale context pollution by selecting context by role, authority, TTL, supersession and token budget.
project_adaptation: Use ContextEngine, MemoryPack, SkillPack, ProjectOSContextPack and ResearchLeadInputContract with replayable compression artifacts.
